The '''Frigia Mountains''' were a naturally occurring [[Mountain/Legends|mountain range]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], agents of rebellion on the planet began operating clandestine data vaults deep in the Frigia Mountains. Using the vaults to skim money from accounts with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], these rebels were transferring [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] off planet in defiance of the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]].<ref name="EV" />
